svg.title: Figure 2 | Handoff Document Self-check
svg.desc: Selections track document review only. The initial 0 / 8 is not software quality, production acceptance or passed independent handoff.

g.font-family: Arial, Noto Sans CJK TC, sans-serif
g.text: Explain purpose, intended users and scope
List required operating systems, versions and dependencies
Provide correct install, test and startup commands
Provide test data, expected results and execution records
Separate verified features from unverified items
Record known limits, risks and excluded uses
Explain error handling, shutdown and data cleanup
Have another person reproduce it independently in a clean
Selections track document review only. The initial 0 / 8 is not
software quality, production acceptance or passed independent handoff.
